lines: Naturally, even while we were making progress by following the memo, groups of Will-o'-wisps kept attacking us.
Me
Ouch... That damn Will-o'-wisp bit me as hard as it could...
It hurt, or rather, it was very hot.
Perhaps due to fatigue from the endless walking, I had ended up getting lightly wounded in the earlier hostilities.
Jisai
That sent a chill down my spine. I thought it had bitten your neck for a moment.
Me
Yeah. I thought I was done for too.
Setting aside masterful fighters like Shishigami and Shonosuke, for an ordinary person like me, the Will-o'-wisps were plenty threatening.
Jisai
But you reacted amazingly and blocked it with your arm. You didn't look at all like someone who is a support specialist.
Me
Is that so? Well, I guess I'm feeling good today, my body feels lighter. I think it was a fluke though.
Jisai
Always so modest... Anyways, how's the wound? Does it hurt?
Shishigami asked with concern.
The way she spoke was certainly detached and dispassionate, but as we walked together, I realized that she actually had a kind personality.
Me
Hmm... I mean, a wound is still a wound... but it's no problem.
Jisai
Really...? But be careful. If you overdo it and collapse, we'll also be in trouble.
Me
No, I'm not overdoing it or anything... it's just my wounds are healing on their own somehow.
Jisai
Shishigami looked at my face fixedly.
Me
(Well, I myself don't understand what's going on either...)
It was the arm that had been bitten, and even burned, by a Will-o'-wisp.
Before I knew it, it had healed to the point where the pain only bothered me a bit.
It was a rate of healing would have normally been impossible.
Me
(Is this the same as when I was stabbed by Gaiza...?)
Jisai
The ability to heal your wounds... that's like Murasaki-sensei. Is that your Ninja Art?
Me
Hmm... I guess that might be it, maybe.
Jisai
What do you mean?
Me
I mean, I don't know anything for sure yet...
Just when I had tried to get a diagnosis for it, I had somehow gotten caught up in this mess.
Shonosuke
Kotaro-sama has awakened to a Ninja Art of healing... That is very interesting.
Shonosuke's eyes narrowed as he listened to our conversation.
Me
Don't tell Gaiza about this. Well, I think he already knows though.
Shonosuke
I'll... leave that to your imagination.
Shonosuke shook his head theatrically.
While we were talking like this―we finally arrived at the last door.
Me
Alright, "8 beyond the flames"ーthat's the final part of the note. If I'm right, then there should be an exit from the labyrinth ahead.
